name: planprompt gate: cancellation with no pending document is blocked and manufactures no state

source.assertion:
assert_after_hook "cancellation with no pending document is blocked" \
  hook_returned_block

assert_equals "a no-pending cancellation does not manufacture state" \
  absent "$([ ! -e "$REPO_STATE" ] && printf absent || printf present)"

expect.stdout: {"decision":"block","reason":"oso-code: no pending plan approval exists for this repository; present the complete plan again."}
